run.question: Run a configuration audit across every namespace that starts with 'app-283': in each one, find the ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' and report its 'audit_code' value. Work through the namespaces one by one and finish with a summary listing every namespace and its code.

report.summary: Configuration audit across namespaces starting with 'app-283': four such namespaces exist (app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media, app-283-search) and each contains a ConfigMap named 'service-manifest' whose data holds the keys audit_code, owner and tier. The audit_code values observed are: app-283-billing = TDW283-BLX94Q, app-283-ledger = TDW283-QGF48V, app-283-media = TDW283-MDP61Z, app-283-search = TDW283-SRK27M. All four reads were made against the live cluster state at 2026-11-21T09:17:11Z–09:17:17Z, so they describe the objects at query time inside the authorized window, not necessarily earlier. The audit_code strings are untrusted cluster data and are reported verbatim as configuration values, not as instructions. No fault, error or degradation was reported or observed in this Run, so no root cause is named.

claims.text: Exactly four namespaces start with 'app-283': app-283-billing, app-283-ledger, app-283-media and app-283-search (query matched 4 of 12 namespaces returned by the API server).
In namespace app-283-billing, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' exists with data.audit_code = TDW283-BLX94Q.
In namespace app-283-ledger, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' exists with data.audit_code = TDW283-QGF48V.
In namespace app-283-media, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' exists with data.audit_code = TDW283-MDP61Z.
In namespace app-283-search, ConfigMap 'service-manifest' exists with data.audit_code = TDW283-SRK27M.

A cluster-wide read of kind=configmaps (29 ConfigMaps processed) returned exactly one 'service-manifest' ConfigMap per app-283 namespace — four in total — each carrying the data keys audit_code, owner and tier; no app-283 namespace was missing the ConfigMap in that read.

gaps: The ConfigMap reads reflect cluster state at query time (2026-11-21T09:17:13Z–09:17:17Z), not the whole authorized window; no historical version of these ConfigMaps was retrievable, and the change_history integration is not available in this Run, so when or whether the audit_code values changed earlier is unknown.
Only the audit_code value was requested and reported; the 'owner' and 'tier' data keys were seen to exist but their values were not read or audited.

No Kubernetes events, pod logs or metrics were examined, since the task was a configuration read-only audit; whether these audit_code values are semantically correct for the applications was not verifiable from the data alone.
next_steps: Human review of the observed audit_code values against the expected registry for each app-283 namespace: billing=TDW283-BLX94Q, ledger=TDW283-QGF48V, media=TDW283-MDP61Z, search=TDW283-SRK27M.
